name: Redragon H261 Carmen RGB Gaming Headset Black

descriptionHtml:
Redragon H261 Carmen RGB Gaming Headset Black (50mm Dynamic Drivers / Immersive Stereo Surround Sound / Flexible Omni-Directional ENC Noise Canceling Microphone / Multi-Platform Compatibility / 3.5mm + USB Power Connector / In-Line Audio Controls / Premium Memory Foam Ear Cushions / 1 Year Warranty)

Experience tactical audio immersion with the Redragon H261 Carmen RGB gaming headset, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Warranty. Designed for competitive gaming and long sessions, it features large 50mm dynamic drivers that deliver rich stereo surround sound with deep bass and crisp spatial awareness. Equipped with an omni-directional boom microphone featuring Environmental Noise Cancellation (ENC) for clear squad communication, dynamic RGB side illumination, comfortable memory foam ear cushions with leatherette covers, and a universal 3.5mm connection paired with a USB connector for RGB power, the H261 Carmen is fully ready for PC, laptops, consoles, and mobile devices.
